# CI-HERO-REFRESH-ASSERTIONS-001
Authority [#2325](https://github.com/anitaguptaoffice/sanguo-slg/issues/2325), companion runner [#2326](https://github.com/anitaguptaoffice/sanguo-slg/issues/2326). Draft NEVER MERGE. This pure component owns the complete evidence decision, with no browser or input capability.
`validateBefore(snapshot)` checks original checked-gold focus and complete raw boundary schema without modifying snapshots.
`correlateCity(arm, rows, returned, returnedAt)` requires object identity with the first sent city request, full sequential rows, finite timing, successful response and no city request in flight at arm.
`validateRefresh(phase, variant, hero)` replays that correlation from saved rows and returned ID; a trusted boolean cannot replace raw protocol, row, descriptor, event or frame evidence.
`validateCompletion(report, {variant,width,provenance})` replays the phase and verifies six clean immutable sources, viewport and completion status. It is necessary but cannot certify runtime A's later database, economy and cleanup checks.
Phase owns cursor/windowStart, before, two raw row points, arm, response, requestRows, settled, three frames, events and eventsEnd. All clocks are finite and ordered; equal wall milliseconds are allowed.
Raw row points use a separate WeakMap registry, retained original/replacement/roster IDs, tag, hero attribute, connection, parent and ancestor IDs. They prove actual same-hero render replacement, not unique RPC causality.
Baseline must show detached old gold, new checked gold, BODY outside and zero or one fully validated original-gold focusout; DOM removal need not dispatch focusout. Fixed must preserve original gold identity/focus with no events. Both require full descriptor/group/projection schemas.
No keydown, input, change, unknown event, overflow, copied active substitution, skipped sample or later-response fallback is accepted.
The executable suite prints exact counter totals across schema, descriptors, group, event, timing, protocol, identity and completion negatives. It exports only synthetic fixtures for the native wrapper tests.
Run `node live_hero_refresh_assertions.test.mjs`; no dependencies or browser are required. Exact source/component and composed reviews plus actual mapping remain publication/use gates; pure tests are not native acceptance.
